source_type: REAL bidirectional flow records from raw PCAP
temporal_window_type: sliding windows constructed WITHIN each communication group
split_method: Group-level stratified split: complete communication groups assigned to partitions before window construction. No group appears in more than one partition.
scaler: StandardScaler fit on training flows only
limitation: Wednesday PCAP (4 small UCAP files) contains only Benign + Brute Force (SSH). Botnet and Web Attack classes require Friday-02-03 and Friday/Thursday-02/22-02 PCAPs. All four classes are required for the final production model.
